name: Stage Control Plus
author: marcho78, kristofferR, edree0x
description: Organize your desktops from one view. Swipe up with four fingers (or press Super+A) and every window steps onto the stage as a live preview, under a bar of all your desktops with live thumbnails. Drag windows onto any desktop; add, remove, reorder and rename desktops, and keep empty ones until you remove them. Type to search, press Space for a Quick Look (Shift+Space in slow motion), Tab to switch between this desktop and every desktop, choose whether the grid spans one display or all of them, and close windows with a click. Liquid Glass styling, configurable hot corners, and a settings window for gestures, shortcuts and looks.

barWidget.description: Stage Control Plus. Click for settings, right-click to open the stage, middle-click for the current app's windows.
